subject: Re: Polaris - one-off SKU swap & billing smoothing request
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-10T09:21:00-07:00
Subject: Polaris request: one-off GPU SKU swap + billing smoothing

Hi team,

Quick summary: Polaris (ML infra team) asked last night for a one-time, month-long swap of 12 reserved A40-like instances to A800-class GPUs in our dedicated pool for a production migration window (they plan heavy fine-tuning). They want the operation to start 2027-04-18 and run through 2027-05-17.

Key asks from Polaris: 
- Temporary SKU swap (A40 reserve -> A800 variant) for 12 units.
- Burst capacity enabled for peak windows (auto-burst up to +30% for 48 hours total across the month).
- Smoothing of overage charges: they request we amortize the burst consumption across their reserved commitment and provide a one-time 25% discount on overage rate for that month.

Constraints: A800 inventory limited in us-west-2; this is non-standard (sku swap + billing concession). Deal value tied to a 12-month renewal they expect to sign after the migration, but procurement wants the migration approved before final signature (they need the migration uplift to validate performance).

Attachments: Polaris_Migration_Appendix.pdf (technical plan)

Asking Lauren and Marcus to validate operational feasibility and Steph for an exec signoff on the billing concession if ops signs off. I tagged a proposed short list of conditions in the attached appendix (pre-approved fallbacks, rollback plan, cap on cumulative burst hours).

Thanks,
Aditya
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-11T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Polaris request: one-off GPU SKU swap + billing smoothing

Team —

Read the appendix. Operational note from Marcus: we can schedule a transient SKU assignment for the requested window but there are two catches:

1) Inventory: A800s are constrained mid-April; to guarantee 12 units we must preempt some burst capacity reservations and mark them as transient (24h notice to other customers).
2) Risk: If Polaris' migration runs over, their reserved capacity will not auto-revert without manual action — we need a rollback automation and a firm end date.

Proposal (deal desk recommendation):
- Approve one-time SKU swap for 12 units for the month 2027-04-18 -> 2027-05-17 conditioned on: rollback policy, a 4-hour oncall window for Redwood infra during first 72 hours, and a documented fallback to A40 if latency regressions occur.
- Approve burst enablement up to +30% but cap total burst hours at 96 hours for the month.
- For billing: offer a one-time smoothing credit equal to 20% of expected overage charges (rather than 25%) applied as a credit against the first invoice after the migration; Polaris must sign the updated SOW addendum and accept a non-refundable operational readiness fee of $12k.

I need exec approval for the deviation on the overage concession and confirmation on the non-refundable fee. Marcus, confirm you can commit the rollback automation and the 24h preemption notification.

I'll loop in Finance if we get a green light.

Thanks,
Lauren
Director, Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Anika Rao <anika.rao@polaris.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Polaris Procurement <procurement@polaris.ai>
Date: 2027-04-13T08:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Polaris request: one-off GPU SKU swap + billing smoothing

Lauren / Aditya —

Thanks for the quick review and the pragmatic proposal. A few clarifications from our side:
- Polaris accepts the 96 hour burst cap, but we would prefer a 30% smoothing credit if possible; the migration economics are tight and that extra buffer unlocks our signoff on the longer-term renewal.
- The $12k operational readiness fee is acceptable.
- We need the migration window to begin no later than 2027-04-18 due to model release dependencies.

We uploaded a redlined addendum to DocuSign (Polaris_MSA_Redlines.pdf) and shared the technical appendix. We can sign the addendum immediately upon exec confirmation of the 30% concession.

Best,
Anika Rao
Head of ML Infrastructure
Polaris Systems

[Attachment: Polaris_MSA_Redlines.pdf (pdf)]
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finance Ops <finance@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-15T17:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Polaris request: one-off GPU SKU swap + billing smoothing — EXEC DECISION

Team,

I reviewed the ask, appendix, and the proposed conditions. Given the strategic nature of Polaris (multi-product renewal expected) and the urgency tied to their release cadence, I approve a one-time concession with tightened constraints:

1) Approve the SKU swap and burst (A40 -> A800) for 12 units, 2027-04-18 -> 2027-05-17.
2) Approve burst cap at +30% and total 96 burst hours.
3) Approve billing smoothing at 25% overage credit (one-time credit applied after migration) conditional on: signed addendum (DocuSign), $12k non-refundable readiness fee received before migration start, and clear rollback automation tested in a staging window by 2027-04-16 EOD.
4) Exception is limited to this single month; no precedent beyond DL-2027-00123. Any changes require a new exec approval.

Marcus: coordinate the rollback test and confirm when completed. Finance: prepare credit accounting entry and ensure readiness fee is invoiced and collected. Aditya / Lauren: please send the formal approval email to Anika and Polaris and attach the signed addendum once received.

Steph
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

[Note: internal exec approval captured in our deal desk system under DL-2027-00123]
